# English hyphenation patterns

`hyph-en-us.tex` is the TeX hyphenation pattern file for American English, Copyright (C) 1990, 2004, 2005 Gerard D.C. Kuiken
(the hyph-utf8 package, https://github.com/hyphenation/tex-hyphen, file `hyph-utf8/tex/generic/hyph-utf8/patterns/tex/hyph-en-us.tex`,
copied on 2026-11-03, unchanged). Its licence: "Copying and distribution of this file, with or without modification, are permitted
in any medium without royalty provided the copyright notice and this notice are preserved." The patterns are built into DSLeaf
(`source/hyph_en.c`, made by `tools/make_hyphen.py`) and the notice is shown on the About screen (decision 093).
